name: Krokstrand - Högstad
routeType: point-to-point official Bohusleden stage; hard upland stage from the Krokstrand/Björneröd start over Löveråsfjället and Björnerödspiggen, then southwest through forest, farms, historic rock-carving country and roads/paths to Högstad

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: Stage 26 Krokstrand - Högstad
keyFacts: Primary official name is 26. Krokstrand - Högstad.
West Sweden Trails facts are 13 km, 5-6 h and hard/red.
Official API length is 13000 m and the current geometry has 1893 coordinate points.
Stage is in Strömstads kommun, Norra Bohuslän, Västra Götaland.
Surfaces include asphalt, gravel/dirt road and forest path.
Route climbs over Löveråsfjället to Björnerödspiggen/Björnerödpiggen, described as Bohusleden's highest and northernmost point and Bohuslän's highest mountain at 222 m.
Summit context includes a Bronze Age cairn, wind shelter, barbecue area, benches and viewing tower with views into Norway in clear weather.
Route then descends southwest toward Högstad via Jörlov-Masslebergdalen with rock carvings and Stone Age passage-grave context at Massleberg/Jörlov.
Official access text names Skog, Krokstrand, Björneröd and Högstad bus stops.

WST places API includes Björneröd/Krokstrand/Skog/Högstad bus stops, Björnerödspiggen and Krokstrand parking, Etapptavla Högstad, Påsholk Högstad, Utsikt Idefjorden, Hällristningar i Massleberg och Jörlov, Grillplats Krokstrand, Vindskydd Sandvatten, Vindskydd Björnerödspiggen and Villa chez KoS.
WST dricksvatten and lager-rastplats category checks returned zero items.
Official status endpoint returned an empty list on 2026-04-30.
caveats: Official Swedish body has a Krokstand typo and English text has machine-translation artifacts.
The official named start is Krokstrand, but the current WST geometry starts near Björneröd/Björnerödspiggen parking rather than Krokstrand village center.
Official GPX elevations are zero and API elevation is null; do not use WST elevation data for profile.
WST place API includes nearby/off-route and adjacent-stage POIs, not only on-route Stage 26 facilities.
